eventDetail.scope: The 8th International Conference on ICT for Development for Africa (ICT4DA 20265) is the  main venue for engineers, developers, and practitioners from academia and industry to present and discuss research work in the area of ICT for Development in AFRICA. The conference facilitates a thematic discussion, and the transfer of knowledge, experience, adaptation of new methods, and where possible strive to foster collaboration among multidisciplinary groups. The topics of interest cover all aspects of ICT leading towards socioeconomic development in emerging economies.
